slot.brief: Figure showing reaction scheme: substituted phenol/ether with positions marked undergoing nitrosation or HI cleavage; identify the major regio-product or cleavage site with explanation.

stem: For nitrosation of the phenol shown in the figure, which is the major mononitroso product?

verdicts.working: OH directs nitrosation to ortho/para positions. The para position is less hindered than the available ortho position, giving 4-nitroso-2-methylphenol.

working:
OH directs electrophilic substitution to ortho and para positions.
The para position (C4) is less hindered than the available ortho position (C6).
Major product: 4-nitroso-2-methylphenol.

Independent check: OH directs nitrosation to ortho/para positions. The para position is less hindered than the available ortho position, giving 4-nitroso-2-methylphenol.
solution: ${-OH}$ directs electrophilic substitution to the ortho and para positions. The para position is less hindered than the available ortho position, so nitrosation gives 4-nitroso-2-methylphenol as the major product.
